prompt: A client constructed without an auth token fails every outgoing request locally with an error instead of sending it. This breaks a logged-out flow that deliberately issues an unauthenticated request so the server can return a typed 401 the UI handles specially; the user instead sees a confusing transport error. Make an empty token omit the auth header rather than block the request, without reintroducing a malformed empty bearer on the wire. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: authorization header omitted when token empty
logged out flow expects typed 401 from server
_subject: Omit Authorization header when bearer token is empty
